title: What the map's statuses mean
intent: The legend the planning figures here use: the map's own two words for a step, and its word for work that waits.

data.label: Done
data.sentence: the step's heading says Done, and its check runs in test.sh

data.label: Left
data.sentence: its Left: line lists what the step did not do

data.label: Blocked
data.sentence: it waits on something outside the plan; no step is Blocked today
